name: Espers to Magicite
oracle_text: Exile each opponent's graveyard. When you do, choose up to one target creature card exiled this way. Create a token that's a copy of that card, except it's an artifact and it loses all other card types.
blocked_sentences: Exile each opponent's graveyard. When you do, choose up to one target creature card exiled this way. Create a token that's a copy of that card, except it's an artifact and it loses all other card types.

needs.what: an `except_` clause on `copy_permanent` (or an equivalent token-copy op) that overwrites the copy's card types -- '...except it's an artifact and it loses all other card types', i.e. set types to exactly [Artifact] on the token copy rather than adding to them
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `copy_permanent` accepts only `colors`, `add_subtypes` and `no_mana_cost` in `except_` (loader rejects any other key), so it can recolour and add subtypes but never change the copy's card types; the copy would come back a creature. `set_types` exists but only as a *static_effect*, which a resolving instant cannot apply as a one-shot copy modification, and a static ability may only read printed characteristics of an object that already exists. `add_subtype` explicitly refuses a `types` key. `create_token` needs a pre-declared token id and so cannot copy an arbitrary exiled card.
